items.name: odia-button
items.title: Odia Button
items.description: A fully rounded, matte button with clean token-driven variants (solid, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link, frame), a built-in loading state, and six sizes. Installs under a unique odia-* name so it never overwrites your base shadcn button.

items.name: odia-dialog
items.title: Odia Dialog
items.description: A Base UI dialog with a borderless rounded-3xl surface and large soft shadow, size presets, faint deula and chakra watermarks, an Ikat-patterned banner header, media slots, and an Ikat ornament strip. Installs under a unique odia-* name so it never overwrites your base shadcn dialog.
